reader.requirement: Every execution of an OPEN of a report file, successful or not, must update the file's I-O status to the 1985 value for the outcome (00, 05, 07, 35, 38, 41 and the others of VII.1.3.5).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.CloseWithLockLocksFileConnector: 38 after CLOSE WITH LOCK keyed to the physical file at 85
DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility: no 61 at 85; a host sharing refusal answers 30

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectBehavior in FileRegistry.cs and FileConnector.cs; EmitOpen has none
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 CLOSE WITH LOCK then OPEN answers 38 and no 61 exists; at 2023 CLOSE WITH LOCK is refused (COBOL0902) and the sharing facility's 61 applies
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1_open_status_updated uses non-report files and INPUT/OUTPUT; not report-file EXTEND outcomes, 07 NO REWIND, or 38

probes.printed: OUTPUT ABSENT 00; OUTPUT WHILE OPEN 41; EXTEND WHILE OPEN 41; CLOSE 00; EXTEND PRESENT 00; OUTPUT NO REWIND 07; OUTPUT AFTER LOCK 38; EXTEND ABSENT NONOPT 35; EXTEND ABSENT OPT 05 (each status preset to 99; USE procedures entered for 41, 38, 35)
error COBOL0902: the CLOSE WITH LOCK phrase was removed in COBOL-2023

reader.notes: Each OPEN outcome sets the connector status (FileConnector.Open, OpenOnceEntered, the 41 and 38 arms), which the FILE STATUS item reflects. 07 for NO REWIND on disk matches 1985 status 07. Classes a, d, f do not reach the rule.

refuter.evidence: Attacked the failing-OPEN outcomes the reader did not try. refute-1985-152/rop16.cob (--std 85, statuses preset 99, USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR entered each time): OUTPUT into a missing directory 30; EXTEND non-optional missing directory 35; OUTPUT of a read-only file 37; EXTEND of a read-only file 37; OUTPUT naming a directory 37; EXTEND naming a directory 35; EXTEND OPTIONAL missing directory 30; OUTPUT OPTIONAL missing directory 30. Every value is one VII.1.3.5 lists for the case (35 never for OUTPUT; 37 'will not support write operations'; 30 otherwise), and where two apply (a directory named for EXTEND: 35 or 37) the choice is the implementor's. cite.py: OK  §1985:XIII.4.5.4 GR16  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR16; OK  §1985:VII.1.3.5 ... GRL2.3c (35 INPUT, I-O, or EXTEND on non-optional not present); OK ... GRL2.3d.1 (37 EXTEND or OUTPUT, file will not support write operations); OK ... GRL2.3a (30); OK ...
